## Days with corrupt vendor implied vols and Greeks (dropped) (6)

- 2019-05-02
- 2019-05-03
- 2019-05-06
- 2019-05-07
- 2019-05-08
- 2019-05-17

On a corrupt-IV day the vendor's implied vols are wrong across the whole surface (near-the-money call and put IVs disagree by more than a factor of two, or one side is ~0), so every Greek that day is wrong. The day is removed and behaves like a missing day. See load.corrupt_iv_days.

Invalid-Greek rows are option-days that pass every other filter but whose vendor implied vol or Greeks are impossible (vega <= 0, gamma < 0, iv <= 0, or vega more than the configured factor away from Black-Scholes). See load.greeks_valid.

Pairs are built on the NYSE calendar, so every day listed above simply has no pair (the day before it loses its forward pair); nothing is bridged across a gap.
